def send_compact(session_id, pane, *, tmpdir=None, run=subprocess.run, sleep=time.sleep) -> str
    # marker present -> DEDUPED (no send); pane busy -> BUSY (no send);
    # else: run(literal_argv); sleep(ENTER_SETTLE_SECS); run(enter_argv); -> SENT
